name: concept-learner
title_zh: 任意概念喂进去，吐出一份七段式自学 HTML
tagline_zh: 报个概念名，Agent、RAG、Transformer 都行，它自动生成一份结构化自学材料：目标、核心问题。
tagline_en: Name any concept—Agent, RAG, Transformer—get a structured, self-contained HTML study guide with objectives, core.
desc_en: This skill should be used when the user wants to systematically learn an arbitrary concept and produce a structured, self-contained HTML study guide. It accepts a concept name (any topic — Agent, RAG, Transformer, Skill, attention, vector database, etc.) as input and generates a 7-section HTML file at learning-materials/<slug>.html, covering learning objectives, core questions, structured explanat
why_zh: 不是问答，是帮你把「搞懂一个东西」拆成可执行的七步，每步都逼你输出，学完自带一份可回看的笔记。
why_en: Not a Q&A—it breaks "understanding X" into 7 executable steps, each forcing output, leaving you with a reusable study artifact.
limit_zh: 只认概念名，不认教材或视频链接；产物是 HTML 学习指南，不含测验题、练习答案或记忆卡片。超出七段结构的内容它不生成。
limit_en: Accepts concept names only, not URLs or files. Output is a 7-section HTML guide—no quizzes, answer keys, or flashcards. Won't extend beyond that.
title_en: Turn any concept into a 7-section HTML study guide
